fields.p_allin_away: ALL_IN win probability for away side (1 - p_allin_home)
fields.market_mid_away: Market no-vig mid for away side (1 - market_mid_home)
fields.model_vs_market_pts: (p_allin_home - market_mid_home) x 100, percentage points; positive = ALL_IN higher on home
fields.p_ratings_only_home: Ratings-only home probability (no market input); null if unavailable
fields.favorite: Side ALL_IN makes the favorite (home on exact 50%)
fields.confidence_tier: toss-up (<55%), lean (55-65%), strong (>65%) based on favorite_prob
fields.layer: EARLY = ratings+market blend (>60 min pre-start); LATE = market price only (<60 min)
fields.fit_cutoff: Last date of data the model fit used (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.angle: Deterministic plain-English summary of ratings vs market and available context (goalies, rest, injuries, surface Elo). Descriptive only, not betting advice
fields.tennis_convention: For TENNIS, home = player 1 and away = player 2 (no real home side)
fields.market_spread_home: v1.2. Book point spread from the home side (negative = home favored), current line as shown by ESPN (DraftKings). NHL = puck line (+/-1.5), not a margin estimate. Null if no line posted (tennis always null)
fields.market_spread_home_price: v1.2. American odds on the home spread side; null if unavailable
fields.market_total: v1.2. Book game total (points/goals), current line via ESPN (DraftKings); null if unavailable
fields.market_total_over_price: v1.2. American odds on the over; null if unavailable
fields.spread_total_as_of_pt: v1.2. When the feed fetched that line from ESPN (PT); ESPN gives no line timestamp. Cached up to 10 min
fields.allin_implied_spread_home: v1.2. Always null: ALL_IN has no fitted margin model, so no principled implied spread exists
fields.n_games_home/n_games_away: v1.2. Team sports: current-season games in ALL_IN's training data through fit_cutoff for each team. Tennis: total singles matches in the player's Elo history (since 2019 data start). See n_definition
fields.n_definition: v1.2. Plain-English meaning of n for this game
fields.nfl_qb_adjusted: v1.2. True if p_ratings_only_home already includes ALL_IN's starting-QB rating with an ESPN Out/Doubtful check (NFL only)
fields.cfb_qb_adjusted: v1.2. Same as nfl_qb_adjusted, for CFB (QB residual rating + Out/Doubtful check)
fields.nhl_goalie_adjusted: v1.2. True for NHL: the starting goalie's GSAx and backup flag are inside p_ratings_only_home
fields.nhl_goalie_source: v1.2. espn_probable or last_starter_fallback (which goalie identity the core used)
fields.nba_availability_adjusted: v1.2. True if ESPN injury availability is in p_ratings_only_home at full weight (NBA). p_allin_home credits only 25% of it when a market price exists
fields.nhl_availability_adjusted: v1.2. As nba_availability_adjusted, for NHL skater injuries (goalies handled by the goalie feature)
fields.weather_adjusted: v1.2. Always false: ALL_IN applies no weather adjustment
fields.venue/venue_city/venue_state/venue_count: v1.2. From ESPN event data (team sports); null for tennis
fields.indoor: v1.2. ESPN venue indoor flag (domes/closed roofs true); null if unknown
fields.venue_lat/venue_lon: v1.2. Coordinates from ALL_IN's venue cache when the venue is in it (NFL/CFB mostly); else null
